# permitio_condition_set (Data Source)

Reads a user set or a resource set by its key, such as one that Terraform does not manage, for use in a `permitio_condition_set_rule`. Only `key` selects the set; every other attribute holds what Permit returns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    permitio = {
      source = "permitio/permit-io"
    }
  }
}

# A user set and a resource set that are managed outside this configuration.
data "permitio_condition_set" "finance" {
  key = "finance"
}

data "permitio_condition_set" "invoices" {
  key = "invoices"
}

# Finance users may read the invoices in the invoices resource set.
resource "permitio_condition_set_rule" "finance_reads_invoices" {
  user_set     = data.permitio_condition_set.finance.key
  permission   = "${data.permitio_condition_set.invoices.resource}:read"
  resource_set = data.permitio_condition_set.invoices.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The key of the user set or resource set to read.

### Optional

- `conditions` (String) The conditions of the set, as a JSON object; read them with `jsondecode`. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.
- `description` (String) The description of the condition set, or null when it has none. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.
- `name` (String) The name of the condition set. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.
- `resource` (String) The key of the resource a resource set selects instances of, or null for a user set. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.
- `type` (String) `userset` for a user set or `resourceset` for a resource set. Setting it does not filter the lookup: Permit's value replaces it.

### Read-Only

- `environment_id` (String) The ID of the environment the condition set belongs to.
- `id` (String) The ID Permit assigns to the condition set.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization the condition set belongs to.
- `parent_id` (String) The ID of the parent condition set, if any.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project the condition set belongs to.
